facts.statement: About 15% of the genetic risk for autism spectrum disorder comes from new mutations that cause haploinsufficiency.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The study used a CRISPR-based gene activation method to target enhancers of the CHD8 and SCN2A genes in human stem cell-derived neurons and brain organoids.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The gene activation method caused a lasting rise in the expression of CHD8 and SCN2A in the mutant cells and organoids.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The treatment restored normal gene expression levels and corrected physiological changes linked to the mutations.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The results support using enhancer-targeted gene activation as a potential treatment for autism and other neurodevelopmental disorders.
facts.subject: other
